subject: Ops KPI snapshot — clarity queue + QBR readiness
messages:
From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Ops KPI snapshot — clarity queue + QBR readiness

Team / Sarah,

Sharing the August KPI snapshot and a short ops checkpoint to get us lined up for the mid-September QBR with Acme. I attached the dashboard PDF and the QBR playbook notes; please add comments directly to the Drive doc (link below). High-level signals to call out: 

- Latency: p50 ~ 32 ms (flat), p95 jumped to 520 ms during a 90-min window on 2027-08-21 (see attached logs).
- Cost: $1.8 per 1M tokens (down 6% month-over-month after batching tweaks), but token mix shift increased infra spend on large-context runs.
- Uptime: 99.92% (two brief incidents, one auto-failover, one impacted region ~EU-1).
- Usage: Active customers +14% MoM; peak RPS increased 28% (midday surge pattern).

Asks:
1) Laura — can you add a short RCA summary (2–3 bullets) for the p95 spike and confirm proposed mitigation for the QBR slides by EOD tomorrow?
2) Evelyn — please capture the customer-facing narrative we should use for Acme (highlight cost improvements + planned latency hardening) and add to the playbook notes.
3) I'll surface the infra action items and proposed canary for the routing change; I plan to propose a conservative rollout during the QBR week.

Attachments: 2027-08-kpi-dashboard-v2.pdf, qbr-playbook-notes.md
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1a2bKPI-DASHBOARD
HubSpot: HS-12345

Thanks — want to have alignment before the prep call on Thu.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Director, Inference Ops
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops KPI snapshot — clarity queue + QBR readiness

Thanks — added a preliminary RCA to the Drive doc (section: Latency incidents). Quick summary here:

- Root cause: concurrent fallback to v2-quantized during a GPU driver restart on a subset of hosts; fallback path increased decoder overhead and caused KV-cache miss cascades for long-context requests.
- Mitigation in prod: recent hotfix reduces fallback aggressiveness and adds a KV cache priming retry (deployed 2027-08-23). Observed tail latency improvement in canaries but the full fleet saw residual p95 noise due to uneven rollout.
- Next step for QBR: propose adding an explicit canary schedule + dashboard widget to show rollout coverage (owner: laura_bennett).

I've attached a zip of trimmed logs that show the correlation window (latency-root-cause-logs.zip). I'll join the prep call and walk infra and runtime specifics for the slide.

Looks good. Quick notes:

- For Acme QBR narrative, let's lead with the cost-per-token improvement and then call out the mitigation plan for latency — customers care about predictability.
- Suggest a single slide: KPIs (latency, cost, uptime, usage) + 3 bullets of what we shipped in the period + 2 bullets of near-term commitments (owner + ETA).
- I'll draft the slide language and add it to qbr-playbook-notes.md by EOD.

Thanks for the quick turn. Action summary and owners (for the prep doc and final QBR slides):

1) Laura: add the RCA slide + proposed canary schedule (owner: laura_bennett) — due 2027-09-08 17:00 PT.
2) Evelyn: customer-facing QBR narrative and slide language (owner: evelyn_hart) — due 2027-09-08 17:00 PT.
3) Dylan (me): finalize the infra rollout notes + conservative fallback plan and update the playbook + HubSpot notes; I'll also coordinate a short rehearsal with CS for Acme (scheduled Fri 2027-09-10).

Deliverables updated: 2027-08-kpi-dashboard-v2.pdf (v2 uploaded), qbr-playbook-notes.md (comments added).
Latent risk to call out during QBR: p95 volatility for long-context requests; mitigation is staged but we should present a conservative SLO window to customers.

Sarah — appreciate you joining the prep call. If there's anything specific Acme wants emphasized, send a note and we'll include it in the slide set.

Best,
—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Director, Inference Ops
Redwood Inference
